$Comment:
The Sawmiller's Hatchet chase, luck-scaled. This file carries the id of a table the RPG Stations jar ships and its own Sawmill already references, so folding this pack REPLACES that table in place: this is the only version live, only one hatchet can ever be granted, and nothing needs to reference it from an extension. Re-tune the chase by editing the numbers below, or replace this file the same way from a pack loading after this one.

THE ODDS. BasePercent 0.0333 IS 1 in 3000, and every point of luck adds a thousandth of a percentage point, up to a ceiling of 0.25 percent. Against the roughly 124 cycles a ten-minute session runs, that reads as: 1 in 3000 with no luck invested, about one trophy per twenty-four sessions; 1 in 1200 at 50 luck, about one per ten; 1 in 762 at 98 luck (a fully claimed Woodcutting skill tree, the realistic ceiling for someone who does not yet own the hatchet), about one per six. So luck is what shortens this chase, and a worker who has put nothing into it faces the longest odds at the bench.

The CapPercent 0.25 ceiling is reached at 217 luck points, past anything the skill tree supplies on its own. It exists so a heavily geared or modded luck source cannot turn a chase into a certainty.

WHICH LUCK. The global MMO_Luck channel and the station's own MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING, and nothing else. MMO_Luck_CRAFTING is left out even though every other table in this pack folds it at half weight: the others reward the whole worker, this one rewards the woodcutter, so a crafting-heavy character does not shorten a woodcutting chase. The hatchet's own +25 MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING never applies here either, since nobody is holding it while chasing it - this curve runs over the luck you bring.

UNITS. hytale:stat returns the folded native MAX of the named channel, and the MMO luck channels store WHOLE PERCENT POINTS, so a full Woodcutting tree reads as 98 here, not 0.98. Do not swap these leaves for the mmoskilltree:station_luck aggregate: it computes a comparable sum but returns a FRACTION, which would shift every number above by a factor of 100. See SawmillLuckFinds for the longer note on units.

THE GATES, unchanged from the plain chase: cycle 5 onward so a passer-by never rolls, plus all three tool axes at the vanilla Mithril hatchet's values (quality 4, item level 50, Woods gather power 0.5, read through the Param-less form that takes the station's own gather type). The win is a command grant rather than a drop table, so the payout is certain once the chance lands, and the fanfare plays with it - a celebration only fires over something actually granted, and a command grant always counts as produced.

Every number here is initial balance and retunes freely without any engine change.
